scope: Internal live catalog producer joined to a fresh acknowledged nonroot source phase; not public catalog operation or complete retained-layout ownership.

findings.title: Producer-owned initial canonical acquisition is outside the supplied shared read ledger
findings.evidence: prepared_catalog_copy_roles creates journal/pool and enters acquire_retained_layout_control_roles before plan_catalog_copy creates the bounded input ledger. There is no surrounding bounded_role_observation. Acquisition calls _project_roles and observe_layout_git_controls plus repeated initial-input validation through ordinary default readers. These initial manifest/conversion/migration/Git observations are not debited to the original copy ledger later subtracted by remaining().
findings.consequence: The newly owning producer cannot claim the supplied aggregate/file/record/metadata policy covers its complete observation span. A later bounded plan can refuse only after setup readers and public marker acquisition already occurred. Existing individual canonical defaults do not provide the original shared operation allowance.
findings.required_change: Create the original shared bounded observation ledger before producer-owned canonical discovery/acquisition, route those observations through canonical bounded hooks, and carry the same incurred usage into plan/staging/handoff rather than resetting the allowance. Ensure policy validation and capacity checks precede the corresponding reads/effects. Preserve default standalone reader behavior.
findings.evidence_limit: Source call-path/accounting finding only; no bespoke budget probe or oversized-input reproduction run.

findings.title: Final native observations do not close actual registry and state lifetime
findings.evidence: _record validates _LIVE and PID/thread/failed/spent/state before calling guard and native fstat/lstat, then returns the earlier mutable record without a trailing registry/state check. close_native similarly obtains its entry record, performs all native callbacks and final guard/fstat/lstat, then returns without a pure original-registry close. spend invokes _record before setting spent, but that lookup again has callbacks after its initial state check.
findings.consequence: The source does not establish the promised actor lifetime after the final callback. A context ending or actor state changing during those observations is not independently rechecked against the original live registry; native FD facts alone cannot establish a still-live actor, particularly if a descriptor number is reused. This is a source-level closing invariant gap, not a demonstrated unauthorized source move.
findings.required_change: Introduce a pure exact-original registry/PID/thread/state/nonce/lifetime check with no filesystem callback, invoke after _record native callbacks and after the last close_native observation, and immediately before one-use state advance. Retire readiness before actual enclosing native teardown. Maintain source-phase/control lifetime checks after participant spend.
findings.evidence_limit: Source-only finding; no custom context-exit/FD-reuse probe executed. Maintained current10 checks ordinary ended contexts and teardown failure but does not exercise this final-callback boundary.

positive_assessment: Actual receiver acceptance binds creating stage/control objects and registry membership, completed finalization and published provenance; normal incomplete entry exit is waived only by matching live producer transfer.
Ready state is assigned only after original resource ExitStack closes normally and original stage/control activity and stage receiver registration end.
Sealed actual namespaces, source observations, original input observations and exact provenance survive teardown rather than being refreshed into a new foreign baseline.

Source plan optionally binds live actor identity and exact provenance observation; absent new fields are omitted from legacy plan documents. Ownership refuses missing actual actor and classifies only actual copied leaves/directories as imported, keeping unknown neighbors unclaimed.

Original control endpoints are filtered by exact old target coordinates; saved provenance/descriptive objects do not mint an actor. Consumption occurs through the complete partition before original source move.
Maintained positive actual source move, metadata publication, finalization and linked Git/new control acquisition pass; these do not resolve the source-only findings.
limits: No bespoke probes/reproduction scripts; findings explicitly source-only.
No independent broad cohort or installed/platform claim.

No historical durable role recovery, restart reconstruction, public copy completion, complete metadata ownership, root/shared/wrapper effects, full namespace ownership, full program or release approval.
All five source/test hashes rechecked unchanged at terminal execution. No implementation/test/pin edits, installs, network or agents. Prior reports preserved.
No independent process remains live. Parent-owned jobs separate; repair may proceed only after their owner considers them terminal.
repair_readiness: Review source sampling and maintained execution complete; exact failing-review subject preserved by manifest. Ready for concrete repaired-source rereview after parent-owned jobs stop.
